tone.target: raw NWOBHM crunch with mid bite and slight fuzz
tone.profile: raw NWOBHM crunch with mid bite and slight fuzz
tone.summary: A tight, aggressive rhythm tone built around a UK 45 or UK SLP model, utilizing an OD pedal for bite and keeping the overall sound dry and focused on upper mids.
corrections: keep fuzz subtle, not main gain

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in aggressive rhythm playing.
Provide the necessary upper-mid bite and tight attack boost without adding excessive gain or modern coloration.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a classic British overdrive/boost (like an early Tube Screamer variant) for mid-range focus, as specific JCM800 models are unavailable.

blocks.purpose: Add the required raw, grainy distortion and subtle fuzz texture without becoming the main source of gain.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style provides a classic, aggressive mid-hump distortion suitable for NWOBHM grit. Settings are kept moderate to avoid excessive saturation.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall-style British amp tone required for NWOBHM.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound matching the Marshall amp model.
Fine-tune the upper-mid bite and punch required for tight rhythm playing.
Placeholder. Wah is not needed for this dry rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: The V-Wah module is included as a required slot but kept inactive to maintain the raw, direct sound.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth and space without sounding lush or modern.
blocks.gap: Delay is used sparingly to add dimension, avoiding the 'lush reverb' trap. Settings are kept minimal.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal amount of natural room ambience to ground the tone without sounding overly wet or lush.
blocks.gap: The reverb is kept very low (15% mix) and short decay time to meet the 'dry rhythm focus' requirement while fulfilling the module slot.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for more aggressive British crunch.

proposals.reason: Enhance the raw, mid-focused bite needed for NWOBHM rhythm.
